277445324.description:
Vintage Glass Insulators Lot - 7 Pieces
Hemingray, Whitall Tatum Co., Made in USA
Clear and Aqua Glass, Early to Mid-20th Century
Collection of seven vintage glass telegraph and telephone insulators, featuring examples from prominent American manufacturers including Hemingray and Whitall Tatum. These utilitarian objects were essential components of the nation's early telecommunications infrastructure, and today they are highly collectible for their industrial aesthetic and varying glass tones.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray - 9 insulator, light aqua glass, embossed mark on base
Whitall Tatum Co. insulator, clear glass, embossed base mark
Made in USA insulator, clear glass, marked 21-52
Made in USA insulator, clear glass, marked 28
Three (3) additional Made in USA insulators, clear glass, various sizes
Condition:
Overall very good vintage condition. Most pieces show typical base roughness and small fleabites consistent with industrial use and age. No significant structural cracks. The glass remains largely clear with some minor surface soot or mineral deposits from outdoor exposure.
